question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'flew'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• From the given options it is evident that we need to use the correct tense form of the **verb fly **for the given blank.
 
• Since the given passage is from the third person viewpoint, we need to use the simple past tense form in the given blank. 
 
• In such a case, flew or option 3 is the correct word for the given blank. 

*Correct passage - **She was flying over the hills and felt delighted at the (1) sight of the tall trees and their (2) sloping branches below her. She could (3) even see a river flowing in a zig-zag fashion. Birds (4) **flew **alongside making chirruping sounds as if (5) **welcoming **her to the skies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **fly - **present tense
 
• **flown - **past participle
 
• **flowed - **past tense of flow
